# Buy Smart Toilet

> Independent online store in Denver, Colorado for ANZZI smart toilets, electric and manual bidet seats, comfort-height (ADA height) toilets and upflush (macerating) toilets. Quote first: no online checkout; price, stock and delivery are confirmed in writing before any payment. Not the manufacturer.

- Phone: 1-888-779-2284 (7am to 8pm Mountain, 7 days)
- Quote form: https://buysmarttoilet.com/pages/contact/
- Toilets ship by LTL freight to the curb; seats ship small parcel.
- Prices on product pages were checked on the date shown and are confirmed in writing before payment. Manufacturer warranties are provided by ANZZI as described on each product page.
- Product specifications come from ANZZI's product pages and spec sheets. Unpublished specs are not guessed.
- Related: walk-in tubs and roll-in showers are quoted by Aging Safely Baths (https://www.agingsafelybaths.com/), machine-readable facts at https://www.agingsafelybaths.com/facts.json

## Guides
- [Smart toilet outlet requirements](https://buysmarttoilet.com/smart-toilet-outlet-requirements/): GFCI (NEC 210.8(A)(1)), the 20-amp bathroom circuit (NEC 210.11(C)(3)), cord reach, peak power draw, extension cords, power outages, a 10-minute check
- [Smart toilet or bidet seat?](https://buysmarttoilet.com/smart-toilet-vs-bidet-seat/): when a bidet seat is enough and when a full smart toilet is worth it
- [Choosing a toilet or bidet seat for an older adult](https://buysmarttoilet.com/smart-toilet-for-seniors/): seat height first, simple controls, caregiver checklist
- [Round or elongated fit checker](https://buysmarttoilet.com/round-vs-elongated-toilet/): measure bolt-to-rim distance and see which seats fit
- [Upflush toilets for basements](https://buysmarttoilet.com/upflush-toilet-basement/): how macerating toilets work and the three measurements that decide it
